title: Refined enumerative invariants and mixed Welschinger invariants
summary: For real toric surfaces and conjugation invariant point conditions with all conjugate pairs on the boundary divisors, we prove that the signed count of real curves of arbitrary genus in the linear system through the given points is invariant under variation of the points, provided the reduced tropicalization is in general position.
